card.name: Central Asia and Russian-steppe place context
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas just before a Central Asian or Eurasian place or people name, such as Kazakhstan, Mongolia, Tatars or Khan. It appears in history and geography text about Russia and its neighbours.

modes.label: Before a Central Asian place
modes.description: A preposition or comma right before a country or region such as Kazakhstan or Central Asia.
modes.example: located in storage at the Baikonur Cosmodrome<< in>> Kazakhstan.

modes.label: Before steppe peoples or rulers
modes.description: A linking word before Tatars, Tartar or Khan in Russian medieval history.
modes.example: in his defeat of<< the>> Tatars in the Battle of Kulik

modes.label: In country lists
modes.description: A comma inside a list of post-Soviet or Asian countries and capitals.

card.writes: It pushes the next word toward Ba- and Bay-type names, as in Baikonur or Bay, and away from Russian-related words.
card.plain: It fires on the little word just before a Central Asian place or steppe people is named, like Kazakhstan or the Tatars.
